source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-13. A function f from Z63 to {0,1}, constant on the 13 orbits of x -> 2x (Frobenius orbits of GF(64)*), chosen by exhaustive scoring of all such f (programs/gdev.c); rows f(x+d) for x in Z63 and their complements, 126 rows; columns are shifts d chosen so that no set of five shifts is bad (programs/palsub.c, seed 1; 7245 of 7028847 five-sets of shifts are bad). programs/recipe.sh runs it; a run from scratch reproduced the array exactly (programs/recipe_log.txt). 28 shifts. Exact check with ca_verify, all 5-sets
construction: Complement-doubled circulant of a Frobenius-invariant function on Z63, columns chosen to avoid bad 5-sets of shifts
notes: eight rows below the cited size 134 at k = 28; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
